hooks.command: bash -c 'test -n "${GAMEDATA_TOKEN:-}" && test -f scripts/cloud_setup.sh && bash scripts/cloud_setup.sh; exit 0'

bash -c 'case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) main="${PWD%/.claude/worktrees/*}"; if [ ! -d target ] && [ -d "$main/target" ] && command -v robocopy.exe >/dev/null; then echo "[seed] copying build output from $main/target"; robocopy.exe "$(cygpath -w "$main/target")" target /E /MT:8 /XD incremental /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP >/dev/null; echo "[seed] done"; fi;; esac; exit 0'
